title: [3.0.0] CGM Eversense integration does not work
body:
AAPS Version: 3.0.0
Build Version: a2411bb51-2022-02-01-08:40
Flavour: fullrelease
NS Version: 14.2.5

Hello,
as already recognized for the RC3 version, the BG reading from Eversense does not work in AAPS 3.0.0. For older versions, it worked with patched ES apk -> ESEL -> MM640g in AAPS.
But this does not work with the new AAPS version. The BG values are simply not available. As workaround, it is possible to get them via xDrip+ (and 640g / Eversense as source in xDrip+), but the direct connection seems to be broken.

Regards
Bernhard
